keyPoints: Vaigyanik khoj ek sawal se shuru hoti hai — phir dhyan se nirikshan, parikalpana banana, prayog karna aur nateeje nikalna, ye kram chalta hai.
Achhe prayog me ek samay me sirf ek cheez badli jaati hai (swatantra char), jabki baaki sabhi sthitiyan sthir rakhi jaati hain taaki sahi kaaran pata chale.
Niyantrit prayog (control experiment) me tulna ke liye ek samooh bina kisi badlav ke rakha jaata hai, taaki badlav ka asar saaf dikhe.
Aankde imaandaari se likhne padte hain — manchahe nateeje chunna ya galat nateeje chhupana vigyaan ke mool siddhant ke khilaf hai.
Prayog ke baad tark se nishkarsh nikala jaata hai aur use doosre vaigyanikon ke saamne rakhkar jaancha jaata hai; aalochna se gyaan majboot hota hai.
Suraksha sabse pehle — prayogshala me suraksha chashma pehnna, dastane lagana aur shikshak ki anumati ke bina kuch na karna zaroori hai.
Aam galti: prayog ko sirf nateeja paane ka khel samajhna; asal me prayog sawal ka jawab dhoondhne ka vyavasthit tareeka hai, nateeja jo bhi aaye.

title: Vigyaan ki Khoj-bhin Duniya
